comment: Edits for chap09.ipynb. Code blocks (code, lstlisting and stdout environments, including ones that only show output) are numbered from 1 in the order they appear in book/chap09.tex. 'after': cells to add after a block (a string of code, or {markdown}). 'prepend': code to put before a block's code. 'static': blocks shown as text, not run. 'errors': blocks that fail on purpose; shown as text, and tests/test_notebooks.py checks that they fail with this Octave message ('show_after': also show the message after that block). 'checks': more code to run after a block, expected to fail with the message. 'solutions': files in code/ (and a call) that solve the chapter's exercises; remove_soln.py blanks them for the student version.
